name: Oil and Natural Gas Corporation Limited
summary: Oil and Natural Gas Corporation Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the exploration, development, and production of crude oil, natural gas, and value-added products in India and internationally. It operates through Exploration and Production, Refining & Marketing, and Petrochemicals segments. The company offers LPG, naptha, ethane, propane and butane, superior kerosene oil, LSHS, high-speed diesel, aviation turbine fuel, liquefied petroleum gas, light diesel oil, MTO, and other products.
